headline: ArcelorMittal Assesses Liberia Mining Investment at Nearly $4 Billion
summary: ArcelorMittal has estimated its total capital investment in Liberia at nearly $4 billion, according to local reports.
why: ArcelorMittal is one of the world's leading steel and mining companies, operating major iron ore extraction and rail logistics concessions in West Africa.

impacts.name: ArcelorMittal
impacts.why: Large cumulative commitments highlight sustained exposure to West African iron ore extraction and export infrastructure.
